title: Finite-stage reduced integral pullback tensor equation
statement:
theorem integralPullbackTensorCompositionReduced_finiteStage
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
        (integralSystemTransition l E) Z n).map
        ((integralSystemReduction l E Z).map
          (((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z Y (h ≫ f) hZ hY) M N).hom ≫
            ((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z hZ)).map (Prod.mkHom
              (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app M)
              (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app N)))) =
      (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
        (integralSystemTransition l E) Z n).map
        ((integralSystemReduction l E Z).map
          (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app
            (((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ Y hY)).obj (M, N)) ≫
            ((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)).map
              ((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY) M N).hom ≫
            ((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)
              (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M)
              (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj N)).hom))

proof.text: Apply integralComparison_reduction to each of f, h and h >> f. Apply finite evaluation and paste with pullbackTensorSystemComparison_evaluation. Naturality of the evaluation tensor and pullback isomorphisms gives finiteComparison_square, with finiteTensorReduction and finitePullbackReduction as the two changes of presentation. This is the proved categorical lemma evaluated_tensor_square in the item module.

Use the unary finite-reduction compositor equation on M, N and their integral tensor, and the already proved canonicalFinitePullbackTensor_composition. Postcompose both evaluated integral maps with the tensor-reduction isomorphism, the tensor of the two h comparisons, and the tensor of h applied to the two f comparisons. Cancel these isomorphisms. Naturality moves the integral compositor through tensor reduction; the unary equations replace its two components by the finite compositor. The finite tensor-composition equation then replaces the composite comparison. Naturality of the finite compositor, the h tensor comparison and the h pullback-reduction comparison, followed by the f tensor-reduction square, identifies the other path. This is the fully proved generic lemma reduced_tensor_composition; it uses neither faithfulness of finite evaluation nor an equality of whole-system maps.
